```{r}
results <- read.table("./LMM-hostprefQTL-QuinqsT.assoc.txt", header = T) %>% 
  filter(af > 0.05) # keep only SNPs where allele frequency > 5%
results <- results[which(results$chr!="NC_014574.1"),] # remove some SNPs found on extra-chromosomal scaffold
results <- results %>% mutate(p_lrt_BH = p.adjust(p_lrt, method = "BH", n = length(results$p_lrt))) #p-value adjustment
results_chromName <- results %>%
  mutate(chr = recode(chr, 
                      "CM027410.1" = "chromosome 1", 
                      "CM027411.1" = "chromosome 2", 
                      "CM027412.1" = "chromosome 3"))

p <- results_chromName %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = -log10(p_lrt), x = as.numeric(ps), color = as.factor(chr))) +
  geom_point(cex = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("grey15", "grey65"), times = 3)) +
  geom_point(data = results_chromName %>% 
               filter(p_lrt_BH < 0.05),
             aes(y = -log10(p_lrt), x = as.numeric(ps)), cex = 1.5, color= "red") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)-value))) + 
  facet_wrap(~chr, nrow = 1, strip.position="bottom", scales = "free_x") +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14)) 

ggsave("GEMMA_full_manhattan.png", plot=p, dpi = 500)

print_top_snps <- results_chromName %>% filter(p_lrt_BH < 0.05)
#write.table(print_top_snps, file="hostprefQTL_signifcantSNPs.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t")

top_snps <- results %>% filter(p_lrt_BH < 0.05)

```

```{r}

gff <- read.table("../../manuscript/FINAL_SUBMISSION/SUPPLEMENTARY DATA/S1_merged_chemosensory-genes_JHB2020v68.gff3",
                  sep = "\t",
                  comment.char = "#",
                  quote = "",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(gff) <- c("seqid", "source", "type",
                   "start", "end", "score",
                   "strand", "phase", "attributes")

genes <- subset(gff, type == "gene")
genes$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+).*", "\\1", genes$attributes)
genes$gene_name <- sub(".*locus=([^;]+).*", "\\1", genes$attributes)
genes$gene_description <- sub(".*description=([^;]+).*", "\\1", genes$attributes)

window <- 171400/2 # 171.4kb came from LD decay analysis on chromosome 3

hits <- merge(top_snps, genes,
              by.x = "chr",
              by.y = "seqid")

nearby_genes <- subset(
  hits,
  abs(ps - start) <= window |
  abs(ps - end)   <= window |
  (ps >= start - window & ps <= end + window)
)

final_hits <- nearby_genes[, c(
  "chr", "ps", "n_mis", "n_obs", "allele1", "allele0", "af", "beta", "se", "p_lrt_BH", 
  "gene_name", "gene_id", "gene_description", "start", "end", "strand"
)]
final_hits <- final_hits %>%
  mutate(chr = recode(chr, 
                      "CM027410.1" = "chromosome 1", 
                      "CM027411.1" = "chromosome 2", 
                      "CM027412.1" = "chromosome 3"))

filtered_hits <- final_hits %>%
  # Sort by gene name, then by the highest effect score
  arrange(gene_id, desc(beta)) %>% 
  # Distinct will keep the version of the gene with the best beta
  distinct(gene_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Re-sort by genomic position for your final table
  arrange(parse_number(chr), start)

candidate_genes <- filtered_hits[
  grepl("^(Or|Obp|Ir|Gr)", filtered_hits$gene_name),
]

#write.table(filtered_hits, file="hostprefQTL_171400bp-window_all-genes.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t")
#write.table(candidate_genes, file="hostprefQTL_171400bp-window_chemosensory-genes.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t")

```

```{r}

# Identify the specific row for Ir179 to give it special formatting
ir179_data <- candidate_genes %>% filter(gene_name == "Ir179")
other_genes <- candidate_genes %>% filter(gene_name != "Ir179")

results_chr3 <- results_chromName %>% filter(chr == "chromosome 3")

p <- results_chr3 %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = -log10(p_lrt), x = as.numeric(ps), color = as.factor(chr))) +
  geom_point(cex = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep(c("grey15", "grey65"), times = 3)) +
  
  # LABEL 1: The 8 other chemosensory genes
  geom_text_repel(data = other_genes, 
                aes(x = as.numeric(start), y = -log10(p_lrt_BH), label = gene_name),
                color = "grey50", size = 3, fontface = "bold.italic",
                box.padding = 0.5, 
                point.padding = 0.2,
                min.segment.length = 0, 
                force = 10,           # Increase force to help vertical stacking
                nudge_y = 6,      # LOCK X-AXIS POSITION
                segment.color = "grey70") +

  # LABEL 2: Ir179 at the peak
  geom_label_repel(data = ir179_data, 
                 aes(x = as.numeric(start), y = -log10(p_lrt_BH), label = gene_name),
                 color = "white", fill = "firebrick", fontface = "bold.italic",
                 size = 3.5, box.padding = 1, point.padding = 0.2,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.02, "npc")),
                 segment.color = NA,
                 nudge_y = 4.4,         # Start it higher to stay at the summit
                 ) +     # LOCK X-AXIS POSITION
  
    # Highlight all significant points in red
  geom_point(data = results_chr3 %>% filter(p_lrt_BH < 0.05),
             aes(y = -log10(p_lrt), x = as.numeric(ps)), cex = 1.5, color= "red") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
  
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)-value))) + 
  facet_wrap(~chr, nrow = 1, strip.position="bottom", scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text=element_text(size=14),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

#ggsave("GEMMA_chr3_manhattan.png", plot=p, dpi = 500)


```

```{r}

#Read in genotypes for the position at QTL peak
genotypes <- read.table("./genotype_per_sample.tsv", header = FALSE)
colnames(genotypes) <- c("SAMPLE", "GT")

#Read in list of identities of BG1 F0s, AG2 F0s, and F2s
F2s <- read.table("./filtered_sorted_bams_F2only.txt", header = FALSE)
F2s <- F2s$V1

#Sort rows from "genotypes" to create BG1 F0, AG2 F0, and F2 tables.
#Do not include rows/samples for which genotype is missing at this locus!
F2s_GT <- genotypes[which(genotypes$SAMPLE %in% F2s),] %>% na.omit() #This one is not really needed.

phen <- read.table("./all_phenotype.sorted.bam.txt", header = FALSE)
colnames(phen) <- c("TYPE", "SAMPLE", "PHEN")

F2s_phen <- merge(F2s_GT,phen,by.x = "SAMPLE")
F2s_phen$GT <- replace(F2s_phen$GT, F2s_phen$GT == "0/0", 0)
F2s_phen$GT <- replace(F2s_phen$GT, F2s_phen$GT == "0/1", 1)
F2s_phen$GT <- replace(F2s_phen$GT, F2s_phen$GT == "1/1", 2)
F2s_phen$PHEN <- replace(F2s_phen$PHEN, F2s_phen$PHEN == 1, "Human-choosing")
F2s_phen$PHEN <- replace(F2s_phen$PHEN, F2s_phen$PHEN == 2, "Switcher")
F2s_phen$PHEN <- replace(F2s_phen$PHEN, F2s_phen$PHEN == 3, "Avian-choosing")
F2s_phen <- F2s_phen %>% mutate(GROUP = ifelse(grepl("BcEV", SAMPLE), "BCs", "F2s"))  


desired_order <- c("Avian-choosing", "Switcher", "Human-choosing")
F2s_phen$PHEN <- factor(F2s_phen$PHEN, levels = desired_order)


F2_plot <- ggplot(F2s_phen, aes(x = as.numeric(GT), y = PHEN, fill = PHEN)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = GROUP, color = PHEN), size = 3, width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +  
    labs(x = expression(bold("no. of alternate alleles")),
       y = NULL) +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "lavender", "lightpink")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", 'purple', "red")) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

F2_plot
#ggsave("QTL_genotype_distribution.png", plot=F2_plot, dpi = 500)
```

```{r GT_extraction, echo=FALSE}

# This section is for spot-checking genotype distributions for interesting SNPs found
# in the partial RDA analysis. Very similar to the above block of code.

# Read in vcf and create unique loci IDs "CHROM:POS"
vcf <- read.vcfR("./hostprefQTL-QuinqsT.filtered-variants.vcf.recode.vcf")
locus_ids <- paste(
  vcf@fix[,"CHROM"],
  vcf@fix[,"POS"],
  sep = ":"
)

#Read in metadata
metadata <- read.csv("QTL_metadata.csv",row.names = 1, header=TRUE, sep=",")
keep <- str_count(rownames(metadata), "-") >= 3
metadata_sub <- metadata[keep, ]

# Extract just GT strings and change to pseudo allele counts
gt <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")

gt_num <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=nrow(gt), ncol=ncol(gt))

gt_num[gt == "0/0"] <- 0
gt_num[gt %in% c("0/1", "1/0")] <- 1
gt_num[gt == "1/1"] <- 2

# Transform to row = individuals, cols = loci
geno_mat <- t(gt_num)

# Name rows and cols correctly
colnames(geno_mat) <- locus_ids
rownames(geno_mat) <- colnames(gt)

geno_df <- data.frame(
  geno_mat,
  check.names = FALSE
)

keep <- str_count(rownames(geno_df), "-") >= 3
geno_matrix <- geno_df[keep, ]

# CHANGE THIS FOR DIFFERENT SNPs!
genotypes <- geno_matrix[,grep("CM027412.1:117545454", colnames(geno_matrix))]

df <- cbind(metadata_sub, genotypes)

desired_order <- c("c", "s", "h")
df$Response <- factor(df$Response, levels = desired_order)


df_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x = as.numeric(genotypes), y = Response, fill = Response)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = Group, color = Response), size = 3, width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5) +  
  labs(x = expression(bold("no. of alternate alleles")),
       y = NULL) +
  guides(fill = "none", color = "none") +
  
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightblue", "lavender", "lightpink")) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", 'purple', "red")) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

df_plot
```
